veranderings.blok: Die son laat die water verdamp
veranderings.rede: 'op die lyn' is vague for a Grade 4 reader; 'aan die wasgoeddraad' names the familiar object plainly.
Keeps the lesson's subject term 'waterdamp' consistent instead of the looser 'damp'.
